programme.desc: Ren Amamiya is starting his life under probation. But on his way to his new school, Shujin Academy, he somehow finds himself in the Metaverse...

programme.title: PERSONA5 the Animation Ep02
programme.desc: Ren begins his new school life, but it's tough being a transfer student, especially when he's labeled as former convict.

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep01
programme.desc: Otto and Garfiel join Class 2 as hustle and bustle returns to the students' daily lives. Meanwhile, Ainz seems to have something important to tell Mr. Roswaal...?

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep02
programme.desc: It seems some transfer students have joined Class 1. Felt and the others are confused with the many similar names in class. Who exactly are they...?

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep03
programme.desc: Mr. Roswaal wants to plant some morning glories and the students of Class 2 are unexpectedly enthusiastic. While they take turns to care for the morning glories, a mysterious shadow appears...

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep04
programme.desc: Under Ms. Wiz's guidance, Class 2 is tasked to make pasta in cooking class in their respective groups. However, the pasta in this world seems to behave rather strangely...?

programme.title: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again Ep05
programme.desc: Ine's memories turn young, to the state before she met Shozo. She asks Shozo to make her fall in love with him again. Ine tries to act normal in front of Yoshiaki and Mino, but struggles.

programme.title: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again Ep06
programme.desc: Shozo and Ine invite Shota and Mino on their honeymoon. At Tokyo, they visit the family of Akemi, their oldest daughter. While garnering attention, the couple fully enjoy their honeymoon.

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep05
programme.desc: The long-awaited transfer student finally arrives in Class 3, where Yunyun was the only student. Yunyun had hoped to become friends with them, but they say something utterly unexpected.

programme.title: Isekai Quartet S3 Ep06
programme.desc: A series of unsettling incidents has Tanya deciding to question the 'Seven Shadows' of Class 1. Tanya heads to Class 1 with Raphtalia's assistance but...?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep01
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? Ep09
programme.desc: Bell's victory against the Minotaur earns him quite the reputation among the other adventures and his abilities are upgraded as well.

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? Ep10
programme.desc: Just when Bell and his group start exploring the intermediate floors of the dungeon, they get into dire straits.

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? Ep11
programme.desc: With their last ounces of strength, Bell and friends reach the safe area in the eighteenth floor.

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? Ep12
programme.desc: Bell and the others prepare themselves to return to the surface when a group of rogue adventurers, envious of Bell's fame, kidnap Hestia in order to set a trap for him.
